offers.title.where: Offer sheet, opened by Offer for it in a sticker's menu on someone else's sticker board: its heading and its screen-reader name; {{no}} is the sticker's No., like No.0042

offers.close.where: Offer sheet: screen-reader label of the X button in the sheet's header, which closes it

offers.credit.where: Offer sheet: fine print beside the sticker, under its No., drawing time and day; {{artist}} is the Original Artist, {{holder}} the owner of the board it's on, each an @handle or LINE name

offers.kinds.label.where: Offer sheet: screen-reader name of the three offer choices (ask, swap, Gratitude)

offers.kinds.ask.title.where: Offer sheet: bold title of the first offer choice, a plain request for the sticker

offers.kinds.ask.note.where: Offer sheet: line under the Ask for it choice; {{holder}} is the board's owner
offers.kinds.ask.note.ja: ふつうのお願いです。受けるかどうかは{{holder}}さんが決めます。

offers.kinds.swap.title.where: Offer sheet: bold title of the second offer choice, trading one of your stickers for it
offers.kinds.swap.title.ja: 自分のシールと交換する

offers.kinds.swap.note.where: Offer sheet: line under the Swap one of yours choice
offers.kinds.swap.note.ja: 交換に出すシールを1枚選びます。

offers.kinds.gratitude.title.where: Offer sheet: bold title of the third offer choice, giving some of your Gratitude for the sticker

offers.kinds.gratitude.note.where: Offer sheet: line under the Offer gratitude choice
offers.kinds.gratitude.note.ja: 手持ちの感謝を少し渡して、ゆずってもらいます。

offers.swap.picker.where: Offer sheet, with Swap chosen: screen-reader name of the row of your stickers to pick from

offers.swap.none.where: Offer sheet, with Swap chosen: shown in place of the sticker picker when you have no sticker to trade
offers.swap.none.ja: 交換に出せるシールがまだありません。

offers.gratitudeAmounts.where: Offer sheet, with Offer gratitude chosen: screen-reader name of the amount choices (100, 250, 500)

offers.send.where: Offer sheet: the main key at the bottom, which sends the offer

offers.waitsForYes.where: Offer sheet: small line under the Send offer key; {{holder}} is the board's owner
offers.waitsForYes.ja: {{holder}}さんがOKするまで、やりとりは始まりません。

offers.sent.title.where: Offer sheet, after Send offer: heading of the confirmation that replaces the sheet's choices
offers.sent.title.ja: {{holder}}さんにオファーを送りました

offers.sent.lead.where: Offer sheet, after Send offer: line under the confirmation's heading
offers.sent.lead.ja: {{holder}}さんがOKするまで、やりとりは始まりません。返事はLINEでお知らせします。

offers.sent.demo.where: Offer sheet, after Send offer: fine print saying the offer is a demo that went nowhere
offers.sent.demo.ja: デモ表示・オファーはまだどこにも送られません

offers.sent.back.where: Offer sheet, after Send offer: the button that closes the sheet, back to the owner's sticker board

app.title.where: Page title in LINE's header as the app opens, before a screen names itself: the app's name

app.pageTitles.board.where: Page title in LINE's header while your own sticker board is open
app.pageTitles.board.ja: あなたのシールボード

app.pageTitles.explore.where: Page title in LINE's header while the Explore tab is open

app.pageTitles.shop.where: Page title in LINE's header while the Shop tab, the ticket shop, is open

app.pageTitles.draw.where: Page title in LINE's header while the drawing screen is open

app.tabs.sections.where: Tab bar at the bottom of every screen: its screen-reader name

app.tabs.myBoard.where: Tab bar at the bottom of every screen: the tab for your own sticker board

app.tabs.explore.where: Tab bar at the bottom of every screen: the tab for Explore, where you find other people's stickers and boards

app.tabs.shop.where: Tab bar at the bottom of every screen: the tab for the Shop, where tickets are bought

app.tabs.showTabs.where: Drawing screen, which tucks the tab bar away: screen-reader label of the grabber at the bottom that brings the tabs back
app.tabs.showTabs.ja: マイボード・さがす・ショップのタブを出す

app.tabs.grabber.where: Drawing screen: text on the grabber at the bottom until it's first used, saying where it leads

app.motionPermission.label.where: Motion permission card, shown once over the app on iPhone: its screen-reader name

app.motionPermission.question.where: Motion permission card, shown once over the app on iPhone: the question it asks
app.motionPermission.question.ja: クロッキーでは、一部のアニメーションや操作に端末の動きを使います。モーションセンサーの使用を許可しますか？

app.motionPermission.allow.where: Motion permission card: the key that grants motion access, after which iOS shows its own prompt

app.motionPermission.dontAllow.where: Motion permission card: the quiet link under Allow that declines

stickers.duration.minutesAndSeconds.where: A sticker's drawing time in fine print, like 4m 52s: on the offer sheet, the Explore feed, the sealed card, a gift, the Mini-game, and in a Gift Message

stickers.duration.minutes.where: A sticker's drawing time in fine print on the minute, like 5m, wherever the 4m 52s form shows

stickers.duration.seconds.where: A sticker's drawing time in fine print under a minute, like 54s, wherever the 4m 52s form shows

stickers.spokenDuration.minutesAndSecond.where: Screen readers only: a drawing time read aloud, the minutes then the seconds, for the fine-print time and a sticker on a board

stickers.spokenDuration.minutes_one.where: Screen readers only: the minutes of a drawing time read aloud, for 1 minute

stickers.spokenDuration.minutes_other.where: Screen readers only: the minutes of a drawing time read aloud

stickers.spokenDuration.seconds_one.where: Screen readers only: the seconds of a drawing time read aloud, for 1 second

stickers.spokenDuration.seconds_other.where: Screen readers only: the seconds of a drawing time read aloud

stickers.artistChip.label.where: Artist chip, the Original Artist's picture and name on a sticker someone else drew: its screen-reader label; {{name}} is their @handle or LINE name

stickers.artistChip.artist.where: Artist chip: small caption over the Original Artist's name, on a sticker's detail, its toolbar and menu, and over stickers as your board first loads

stickers.artistChip.by.where: Artist chip, one-line form for tight rows: before the Original Artist's name, as in By @alice

stickers.keptStickers.notLoaded.where: Give sheet, and the offer sheet with Swap chosen: alert when your stickers fail to load; {{reason}} is the error message
stickers.keptStickers.notLoaded.ja: 手持ちのシールを読み込めませんでした：{{reason}}
